src/vc_attn/_sass_d.py.origin: Local B200 native scheduling adapter; no upstream source file.

src/vc_attn/_sass_runtime.py.origin: Local B200 native scheduling adapter; no upstream source file.
src/vc_attn/_sass_runtime.py.transformation: Disable D before compiler inspection or object export by default; experimental callers must explicitly pass enable=True. Patch algorithm and exact-match guards are unchanged.

local_modifications.name: fused_skip_softmax
local_modifications.description: Opt-in B200 packed-V FP8 skip-softmax with split ExpCast, fused denominator, and inline rescale; retains dense probability encoding and executes all PV MMA.

local_modifications.name: b200_dense_fusion_gates
local_modifications.description: Allow nonnegative scan offsets on the dense B200 FP8 ExpCast fused path. Remove the total_q*H packing cutoff for eligible single-sequence calls with Sq/Sk >= 32768; retain all alignment/feature guards and the original fused-skip size policy.

local_modifications.name: b200_fusedpipe
local_modifications.description: For dense B200 E4M3 attention with a nonnegative compile-time mid-window offset with Q/K/V descales and a per-block K descale on CuTe DSL 4.6.0, prefetch the current K-block descale before the score wait and preload both 64-column O halves before inline rescale. Preserve the original correction path outside this configuration, probability/denominator arithmetic, and all publication barriers. Packing dispatch is unchanged.

local_modifications.name: b200_sass_score_interleave
local_modifications.release_status: experimental; disabled in public API and benchmark; private helper requires enable=True
local_modifications.description: Apply the validated two-body score-load/max scheduling patch to a verified SM100 native-code family. Bind four scan-offset immediate fields to the requested compile-time window, normalize those fields for complete pre/post code fingerprints, and require every other code bit and all executable metadata to match. The CuTe DSL 4.6 per-function adapter preserves the ABI and exported AOT window, and leaves unmatched instruction layouts unchanged. No binary artifact or global compiler hook is distributed.

local_modifications.name: prepacked_v_input
local_modifications.description: Opt-in exact padded sequence-contiguous V input for fused preparation. Validate shape, strides and allocation extent; require the existing packed dense dispatch and skip only the redundant transpose_v. Attention kernel arithmetic, compile key and scheduling remain unchanged.

native_v6.note: Original SM103 native v6. Requires tcgen05.ld.red; not supported on SM100. Kernel and host guard unchanged.
